name: amir-skills
description: Personal marketplace for Claude Code skills. MCP servers are distributed separately via Desktop Extensions (.mcpb) — this marketplace only carries skills.

plugins.name: aspg-weekly-harvest
plugins.description: ASPG Weekly Harvest — scans the last 7 days of Outlook/Calendar/Teams for shareable customer, partner, and opportunity signals, and renders a review page (checkboxes, editable wording) with a one-click Contribute button (plain-connector-name MCP addressing), falling back per-row to a paste-back-to-chat step, instead of copy-pasting the original starter prompt every week. Currently pinned to the dev ASPG connector only.
